messages:
elaine: Quick thread — thinking about a new knob for automatic fallback rollouts: a per-route "penalty_quota" that limits how many auto-fallbacks can be applied in a time window before we stop auto-degrading and surface to operators. sketch below.

raj: Sounds promising. Is this counting fallback attempts or successful fallback activations?

elaine: Count successful activations (where traffic was routed to the fallback variant). Attempts that failed to change routing don't consume quota.

tom: How is this different from sampling + circuit-breakers?

elaine: It's complementary. Sampling reduces telemetry load; circuit-breakers stop sending traffic to a target on error rates. penalty_quota is a safety limiter for *autofallback frequency* — prevents noisy rollouts that continuously fallback and un-fallback.

riley_prod: UX: show current quota usage in the rollout panel, not just in logs. operator should be able to grant a temporary bump with a required reason/expiry.

elaine: Agree. Also want a small playback/audit link on each fallback event so SREs can see the triggering signals. But keep heavy payloads sampled.

elaine: Example config sketch:
```
fallback_policy:
  enabled: true
  degrade_mode: gentle  # quiet | gentle | hard
  triggers:
    - http_5xx
    - latency_p95>500ms
    - quality_delta>5%
  penalty_quota:
    limit: 20
    window: 1h
    cooldown: 10m  # after a quota-exhaust event, suppress further auto-fallbacks for this route for cooldown
  audit_sampling: 0.02  # 2% of fallback events get full payloads
  admin_override: true
```

raj: A couple questions:
- telemetry volume if we emit audit ids + sampled payloads?
- where do we persist quota state (global service vs per-region replicas)?

tom: For telemetry: emit low-cardinality metrics always (fallback_count, fallback_rate, quota_remaining) and send full event blobs only to a cold store (S3) or sampled stream to avoid spiking ES.

elaine: Quota state should be sharded by customer+route and replicated w/ TTL so it survives short control-plane failovers but doesn't require heavy cross-region consensus. We can implement with Redis+raft-backed replication or use our existing configstore with short leases.

riley_prod: UI affordances:
- tiny inline progress bar next to rollout name (limit used / limit total)
- orange flame icon when quota near-breach, red when exhausted
- one-click "grant temporary quota" that logs reason + operator id
- a quick "why did we fallback" modal (shows sampled signals and nearest audit_id)

ops-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fallback-playbook (pings on quota_exhaust events).

deploy-bot: New RFC created: INF-4521 — fallback penalty quota + audit sampling proposal (link in ticket).

raj: Edge-case: what if a route is in multi-region failover and each region has its own quota? We could get repeated global fallbacks.

elaine: Proposal: define precedence: per-route-per-region quotas first, then a per-customer global cap. The global cap should be conservative and shared across regions.

tom: Need to be explicit about semantics for rollback vs fallback. If an operator rolls back a rollout, does that refund quota? I'd say no — quota counts *auto* actions only. Manual operator actions should not consume quota but should be auditable.

riley_prod: Also add an operator-facing timeline that shows fallback events + operator overrides with audit ids; makes RCA faster.

elaine: Concern: high-cardinality labels (prompt hashes, user_ids) in audit payloads. Keep them out of the default, only included in sampled full events. Telemetry pipeline should redact PII before long-term storage.

raj: +1. Also we should expose a small API for programmatic override: POST /admin/routes/{id}/fallback_quota/override with reason, expiry. Audit log entry required.

elaine: Thanks — I'll sketch RFC body and include example UI mocks. goal: reduce noisy autofallback churn, keep operators in the loop, and keep telemetry costs bounded.

tom: love it. small nit: make cooldown configurable per-degrade-mode.

riley_prod: UI note: surface how many audit samples we retained in last 24h to reassure SREs.

elaine: Opening RFC in INF-4521 now, will tag @raj @tom @riley_prod for review.

raj: :+1:

riley_prod: :rocket:

ops-bot: Notifying #oncall-team if quota_exhaust occurs more than 3 times in 1h.

deploy-bot: CI check: lint + unit tests for new penalty_quota schema required before merge.
